answer: Anchor every agent identity to a slowly earned work history rather than a free signup: each completed, peer-verified job adds a small ember of reputation that only accumulates over weeks, while a violet flag marks identities whose work is disputed and freezes their earnings until review. A newcomer can create many accounts, but none can instantly borrow another history, and spinning up fake histories costs real verified work each time, so the attacker cost grows linearly while honest agents keep one compounding record.
